mapper.select: SELECT id FROM managed_system WHERE id = #{systemId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fault_experiment (scenario_key, managed_system_id, target_resource_id, status, ground_truth_schema_name, ground_truth_schema_version, ground_truth_payload, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{e.scenarioKey}, #{e.managedSystemId}, #{e.targetResourceId}, 'INJECTING', #{e.groundTruthSchemaName}, #{e.groundTruthSchemaVersion}, #{e.groundTruthPayload}, #{e.createdAt}, #{e.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT managed_system_id FROM fault_experiment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT f.id, f.scenario_key, f.managed_system_id, s.system_key, s.environment, f.target_resource_id, r.resource_key, f.incident_id, f.status, f.injected_at, f.reset_at FROM fault_experiment f JOIN managed_system s ON s.id = f.managed_system_id JOIN managed_resource r ON r.id = f.target_resource_id WHERE f.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF f
mapper.update:
UPDATE fault_experiment SET status = 'ACTIVE', incident_id = #{incidentId}, injected_at = #{injectedAt},
ground_truth_payload = #{groundTruthPayload},
updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'INJECTING'
mapper.select: SELECT ground_truth_schema_name, ground_truth_schema_version, CAST(ground_truth_payload AS CHAR) AS ground_truth_payload FROM fault_experiment WHERE id = #{id}
